play.title: Trippi: Group Travel Expenses
play.short_description: Split trip costs in any currency and see who owes whom, even offline.
play.full_description:
Travel together, split smarter. Trippi keeps track of everything your group spends on a trip and works out who owes whom, so nobody has to do the maths at the end.

Create a trip, add your travel crew, and log each cost as it happens: the apartment, the dinner, the taxi to the airport. Trippi does the rest.

SPLIT IT YOUR WAY
• Split equally, by percentage, or by exact amounts
• Choose who was part of each expense
• Shares always add up to the cent

ANY CURRENCY
• Over 150 currencies
• Exchange rates filled in for you from the European Central Bank reference rates
• Works offline with the last saved rate, or enter your own
• Every expense keeps the rate it was saved with

SETTLE UP FAST
• See at a glance who gets money back and who owes
• Suggested payments use the fewest transfers possible
• Record payments and keep a payment history

SEE WHERE THE MONEY WENT
• Total spent, number of expenses and average per person
• Spending by category with a clear chart
• Share a plain-text summary in any chat app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• Your trips are stored only on your phone
• Light and dark mode

TRIPPI PREMIUM
Upgrade for unlimited trips and travellers, daily and per-person stats, PDF and Excel exports, the exchange rate on the expense date, custom categories, backup and restore, accent themes, and no ads. Premium is a monthly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. It renews automatically until you cancel it in your store's subscription settings.

The free plan includes up to 3 trips with up to 6 people each and shows a few clearly labelled sponsored cards. You can also watch a short video to unlock Premium features for 24 hours.

privacy.notes: Trips, names, expenses and payments stay on the device and are never collected. Exchange-rate requests to api.frankfurter.dev contain only currency codes and dates. Google Play Data safety (from Google's 'Prepare for Google Play's Data safety section' page for the Google Mobile Ads SDK, checked 2026-10-11): the SDK collects AND shares IP address (Location: Approximate location), User product interactions (App activity: App interactions), Diagnostic information (App info and performance: Crash logs, Diagnostics) and Device and account identifiers (Device or other IDs) for Advertising or marketing, Analytics, and Fraud prevention. Data is encrypted in transit (TLS). Answer 'Yes' to collected and 'Yes' to shared for these four types. Collection is required for ads on the free plan (not optional); users cannot request deletion because the app holds no account data. Note: docs/SPEC.md said 'not shared beyond that SDK'; Google's page says the SDK collects and shares, so the store answers follow Google's page. Apple privacy labels (from Google's 'Data disclosure for the App Store' page): Location (Coarse Location), Identifiers (Device ID), Usage Data (Product Interaction, Advertising Data), Diagnostics (Crash Data, Performance Data); purposes Third-Party Advertising and Analytics. Google's page does not state 'linked to you' or 'used for tracking'; the app never requests the IDFA and sends non-personalised requests on iOS, so mark them Not Linked to You and not used for tracking, after confirming with the Xcode privacy report of the bundled Google Mobile Ads SDK privacy manifest (not verified here: the iOS build has not been run). Premium subscribers make no ad requests.
